## Dilemma v0.1.2-alpha

### New

- Easy, medium and hard difficulty for random quizzes, saved topics and scheduled generation.
- Optional server difficulty default, with existing topics retaining their own level.
- Difficulty displayed with each quiz and in topic summaries.
- Localized help and Dilemma-style feedback in English, Polish, German, Spanish, French and Japanese.
- Clear permission, validation, quota and timeout messages.

### Fixes

- Server language now applies globally, including previously created topics, manual runs and scheduled generation.
- Changing language does not change topic difficulty or question count.
- Command interactions are acknowledged before database work.
- Onboarding language changes require Manage Server permission.
- Neon migrations use a direct connection, with a safeguard against mismatched databases.

### Upgrade notes

- Existing topics and poll records receive medium difficulty through an additive migration.
- Previously published content is not retroactively translated. Custom answer options stay as entered.
- Free AI provider rate limits still apply.
- A high-severity advisory in the Prisma CLI dependency chain remains pending a separately tested dependency update.

### Verification

- Type-check, build, SQLite migration, AI timeout/queue and feature regression tests passed locally.
- Difficulty migration was also tested on an isolated PostgreSQL copy before deployment.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/mwazqa/Dilemma/blob/v0.1.2-alpha/CHANGELOG.md).
